question: Are the sealed liquid-perpetual losses predominantly compatible with common BTC price exposure, or do they remain after specific entry-notional benchmark comparisons?
purpose: Diagnose strongest exposure/selection alternative before registering another economic strategy. Ex-post accounting only; no new signals, accounts, parameter search or portfolio admission.
selection: All8daily_archive continuous2025_2026 noncash accounts from the original frozen four-family sparse matrix, plus all4new MAX7/ordinary7 accounts. Both original cost cases, no source/outcome winner selection. These are12existing correlated policy/cost paths, not12independent mechanisms/trials.
accounting: At each5m valuation: reference-price delta = NAV delta - actual funding cash + actual fees + modeled execution slippage + delta[(fee+slip)*actual gross marked exposure]. Full closed-path sum independently reconciles to sum of entry/exit reference-price PnL. This is fixed-path accounting, not a no-cost strategy replay.
benchmarks: Entry-notional BTC price match: at actual entry fill t, buy/sell side*q*raw_alt_close[t-5m]/raw_BTC_close[t-5m] BTC shares; partial exits unwind pro rata, additions use fresh entry-notional match. No market move is earned before the actual entry close.

Entry-beta BTC price match: same construction multiplied by past60daily OLS beta available at entry SUBMISSION clock, current identity episode only. Compute separately from both retained daily-source variants. No fitted full-period beta; no backfill of missing coefficients. Any unknown active entry makes that benchmark interval and whole-account complete beta attribution unknown.
beta_rule: Reuse frozen source-bound sparse feature_views/max_effect60d beta, with numerical variance floor1e-12, first partial day exclusion, no calendar compression and episode resets. Use submission day00UTC feature (shifted to prior complete daily close), never fill-day future data. A missing coefficient is not0or1.
limits: BTC is a narrow benchmark, not proof of exposure to all crypto risks. A negative residual under these specified comparisons is not causal proof of selection failure or proof that a funded hedge would work; hedge costs/capital/stops/inventory paths would differ. Comparing matched fills does not match realized volatility. No return annualization, pruning bad coins/weeks, new hedge replay or changing old rules.
decision: If both price and complete benchmark-adjusted price remain negative across the compared cases, retain evidence against merely repairingBTCdirection/cost as a sufficient explanation and require a different raw-information mechanism before another price-ranking trial. If benchmark matching reverses sign, investigate benchmark misfit/risk rather than declarealpha. If key attribution inputs are missing, report that component unknown. All prior financial rejections remain unchanged regardless of residual signs.
time_concentration: Use5m NAV-based economic price increments for loss weeks, not date of final trade realization. Report net, reference-price and benchmark components; zero post-halt intervals stay in full-path series and are excluded from joint-active descriptive correlations only with sample counts disclosed.

method_sources.use: Benchmark validity, holdings/transaction-based attribution and limitations; no claim the local formula is a full Brinson or causal model.
Attribute against an explicitly specified benchmark; separate measurement, attribution and investment skill claims.
